label: emil-design-eng
summary: Interaction and motion craft on a chosen design: which easing, duration and property an animation uses, and which animations a page should not have. The second skill `page-design` applies.
why: No API key and no paid product. One skill is installed out of a pack of 19 (counted in the repository's skills/ folder on 2026-11-13): loading the whole pack costs context `page-design` does not need. Installing runs the third-party `skills` CLI through npx, which needs Node.js 22.20 or later.

install.run: npx -y skills@latest add emilkowalski/skills --skill emil-design-eng -a claude-code -y
install.note: The pack's README documents only `npx skills@latest add emilkowalski/skills`, which installs every skill. `--skill`, `-a` and `-y` are options of the `skills` CLI (vercel-labs/skills, docs/commands.md, read 2026-11-13); the skill folder skills/emil-design-eng exists in the pack. This exact command was not run by cckit's authors. Per the CLI's docs it installs into the current project (`-g` would make it global): a copy under .agents/skills/, a link at .claude/skills/emil-design-eng, and an entry in skills-lock.json.

verify.failsOn: The skill file is in neither this project nor ~/.claude/skills.

afterInstall: reload the agent session so it lists the skill, and commit .agents/skills/emil-design-eng, .claude/skills/emil-design-eng and skills-lock.json

drifts: the package name skills on npm and its `add` options --skill, -a, -y
the skill folder name emil-design-eng in emilkowalski/skills
that a project install for claude-code lands in .claude/skills/
